name: worktrees-manager-mod
description: A /worktrees side panel: colored, named worktrees with one-line tasks, fast session switching, and per-worktree dev-server ports Claude respects

copyEnvFiles.title: Copy .env files into new worktrees
copyEnvFiles.description: Copy the main worktree's git-ignored .env files (they often hold secrets) into each worktree the panel creates. Off: nothing is read, and the panel offers a Copy button that names the files
